name: Ashta Veerattanam — the Eight Shrines of Shiva's Heroic Deeds
theme: Eight Shiva temples, each commemorating one of Shiva's heroic victories over forces of pride and destruction
region: Tamil Nadu (Cuddalore, Kallakurichi, Thanjavur, Mayiladuthurai and Tiruvarur)
description: The Ashta Veerattanam are eight temples of the Tamil country where Shiva is worshipped as Veerattaneswarar, the lord of heroic deeds, each shrine remembering one of his victories: the burning of the three flying cities, the slaying of Andhakasura, the burning of Kama, the severing of Brahma's fifth head, the defeat of Yama to save the boy Markandeya, the destruction of Daksha's sacrifice, the subduing of the elephant demon and the vanquishing of Jalandhara. Most of them are Paadal Petra Sthalams praised in the Tevaram. Thiruvathigai holds a special place as the scene of Appar's return to the Shaiva faith, and Thirukkadaiyur, where Markandeya was saved, is where devotees mark sixtieth and eightieth birthdays.
